Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_record_found VARCHAR2(1);
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct u.inter_code x, inter_desc y,
 decode(inter_type, 'N', 'NFT', 'H', 'HOLD') z
 from valid_interdictions_lab v, unit_interdictions u
 where u.inter_code = v.inter_code
 and u.source_test_id = :control_mode
 and u.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,sysdate+365)
 and exists (select *
 from units us
 where drive_id = :drive_id
 and us.coll_date = u.coll_date
 and us.chapter_id = u.chapter_id
 and us.unit_id = u.unit_id)
 order by 3,1;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :dummy_var := :drive_id;
 go_block('interdictions');
 temp_record_found := 'N';
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 temp_record_found := 'Y';
 :s_inter_code := c1_rec.x;
 :s_inter_desc := c1_rec.y;
 :s_inter_type := c1_rec.z;
 down;
 end loop;
 if temp_record_found = 'N'
 then
 message('Drive has no interdictions');
 GO_ITEM('batch_id');
 else
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
 GO_ITEM('s_del_flag');
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 tmp_inter_code VARCHAR2(4);
 tmp_desc VARCHAR2(1);
 rec_count number := 0;
 indx number;
begin
 last_record;
 rec_count := to_number(:system.cursor_record);
 first_record;
 for indx in 1..rec_count loop
 GO_ITEM('s_del_flag');
 tmp_desc := :system.cursor_value;
 if tmp_desc = 'X'
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_inter_code');
 tmp_inter_code := :system.cursor_value;
 if :control_mode = 'DRIVE'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where drive_id = :drive_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'BATCH'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where batch_id = :batch_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'TBID'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select 'x'
 from utrs u
 where tb_id=:tb_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base u
 where tb_id=:tb_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 union
 select 'x'
 from holding_tests h
 where tb_id=:tb_id
 and h.unit_id = a.unit_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'ITBID'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 --and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select 'x'
 from holding_tests u
 where tb_id=:ctrl_blk_7.int_tb_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 --and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 --and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id
 union
 select 'x'
 from unit_test_base u
 where tb_id=:ctrl_blk_7.int_tb_id
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id);
 --and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 --and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 elsif :control_mode = 'LOT'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where lot_number = :lot_number
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.coll_date = a.coll_date
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :control_mode = 'COLL DATE'
 then
 begin
 delete from unit_interdictions a
 where inter_code = tmp_inter_code
 and a.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and exists (select *
 from units u
 where coll_date = :collect_date
 and u.unit_id = a.unit_id
 and u.chapter_id = a.chapter_id);
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 end if;
 down;
 end loop;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 commit;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_success
 then
 show_error('8010');
 else
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :system.message_level := 0;
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
end;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_units IS
where_clause varchar2(500);
where_clause1 varchar2(500);
BEGIN
 go_block('units_info');
 clear_block(no_validate); 
 :system.message_level :=10;
 where_clause := ' unit_id in (select u.unit_id from unit_interdictions u '||
 ' where inter_code is not null '||
 ' and u.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id) ';

 if :ctrl_blk_1.drive_id is not null then
 where_clause1 := ' and drive_id = :ctrl_blk_1.drive_id ';
 elsif :ctrl_blk_2.batch_id is not null then
 where_clause1 := ' and batch_id = :ctrl_blk_2.batch_id ';
 elsif :ctrl_blk_3.collect_date is not null then
 where_clause1 := ' and trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:ctrl_blk_3.collect_date) ';
 elsif :ctrl_blk_4.lot_number is not null then
 where_clause1 := ' and lot_number = :ctrl_blk_4.lot_number ';
 elsif :ctrl_blk_5.tb_id is not null then
 where_clause1 := ' and units.unit_id in ((select unit_id from utrs ' ||
 ' where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_5.tb_id and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id) '||
 ' union '||
 ' (select unit_id from unit_test_base '||
 ' where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_5.tb_id and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk.s_chapter_id) )';
end if;
where_clause := where_clause||where_clause1;
set_block_property('units_info', default_where, where_clause);
set_block_property('units_info', order_by, 'unit_id');
execute_query;
:system.message_level := 0;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: POP_UNIT_INFO_INST
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE pop_unit_info_inst (pl_tb_id in varchar2) IS
 cursor unit_cur is select distinct unit_id, coll_date from holding_tests where tb_id =pl_tb_id;
 pl_coll_date date; 
BEGIN
 go_block('UNITS_INFO_INST');
 clear_block;
 FOR Z in unit_cur loop
 
 If Z.coll_date is null then
 begin 
 select coll_date into pl_coll_date from units where unit_id=Z.unit_id
 and rownum=1;
 exception when others then 
 pl_coll_date:=null;
 End;
 Else
 pl_coll_date:=Z.coll_date; 
 End If; 
 
 
 :UNITS_INFO_INST.UNIT_ID:=Z.unit_id;
 :UNITS_INFO_INST.coll_date:=pl_coll_date;
 :units_info_inst.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(Z.unit_id,null,null);
 next_record;
 END LOOP;
 first_record;
 set_block_property('UNITS_INFO_INST',update_allowed,property_false);
 set_block_property('UNITS_INFO_INST',insert_allowed,property_false);
 
END;
